chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sabati, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the prayer of the eclipse, whether it is prayed in congregation or individually, so he said, 'Choose whichever you prefer.'
ai.seo_question: Is the eclipse prayer performed in congregation or individually?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the flexibility in performing Salat al-Kusuf is highlighted, reflecting the Shia juristic view that the eclipse prayer is a recommended act (mustahabb) rather than a strict obligation with fixed procedural constraints. This permissibility to choose between congregation and individual performance underscores the adaptability of ritual worship to communal and personal circumstances, a principle often derived from the broader Quranic ethos of ease in religious practice.
